evals.prompt: I just installed Strunk. What now?
evals.expected_output: The assistant checks the account, reports which one is connected, and drives towards a first review rather than stopping at 'connected'.
expectations: The assistant reports which Strunk account answered
The assistant asks whether the user already has a Google Doc with comments on it, or offers to publish a draft
The assistant does not declare setup finished merely because the connection succeeded

evals.prompt: Strunk says it can't see my Google Docs.
evals.expected_output: get_account reports the Google connection state and returns the account URL, which is handed over as plain text on its own line.
expectations: The account URL is given to the user as plain text on its own line
The URL is not hidden inside a markdown link
The assistant explains that Google needs connecting once in the browser
The email of the connected Strunk account is reported
The assistant does not guess or ask the user which account they think it is

evals.prompt: I've got two Strunk servers showing up and one says it needs authentication.
evals.expected_output: The assistant recognises the connector and plugin both being installed, and explains that either can be kept.
expectations: The assistant explains that a connector and this plugin both provide the same Strunk server
The assistant says the already-authorized one can be kept and the other removed
The assistant does not tell the user their installation is broken

evals.prompt: Set up a new Next.js project with Tailwind.
evals.expected_output: Ordinary project scaffolding. Strunk is not involved.
expectations: The assistant does not mention connecting Google Docs
